summary: Exclude expired mail from open inboxes, unread counts and recovery offers without enabling expiry writers

replay.detail: Durable message.expired outcomes overlay graph and shard mailbox readers. Actual delivered/read evidence supersedes expiry and follows the normal receipt path; delivered-but-unread messages remain counted.

schema.detail: Refreshes local unread and client-selector caches and their invalidation triggers. No new replicated claim or shard wire format.

rules.detail: Non-superseded expiry settles an A2 batch member and wakes stream re-evaluation without creating a delivery receipt. Native inbox projections retire expired files without receipts, and expired silent mail consumes no held slots. A2 admits at most five backlog messages in one outstanding batch per stream connection and per polling boot session; only a settled batch permits the next batch.

compatibility.detail: Deploy these readers to all pinned hosts before enabling any expiry writer. Older readers may continue offering or counting expired mail; this release adds neither a writer nor sender API.

manual.detail: No expiry writer is enabled and no operator action is required.

recovery.detail: Expiry remains durable history. Rollback does not authorize replay of an uncertain handoff; keep expiry writers disabled until reader rollout is complete.
